Vendored imap-proto 0.10.2 from crates.io.
Upstream: https://github.com/djc/tokio-imap
Source commit: 08f269400ec95b176d30cac7b23730820fe94d7e
Original crate SHA-256: 16a6def1d5ac8975d70b3fd101d57953fe3278ef2ee5d7816cba54b1d1dfc22f

The app uses imap 2.4.1, which requires imap-proto ^0.10.0.
The [patch.crates-io] override preserves that dependency and its API.

Local change in src/macros.rs (2026-10-03): remove the trailing semicolon
from the function-expression forwarding arm of paren_delimited!,
parenthesized_list!, parenthesized_nonempty_list!, and opt_opt!.
This fixes Rust's semicolon_in_expressions_from_macros future incompatibility
without suppressing the lint or changing the parser's return values.
Additional warning-only cleanup exposed by building this crate locally:
- src/lib.rs and src/parser/rfc3501.rs: explicitly write inferred '_ return lifetimes.
- src/parser/rfc5464.rs: explicitly write inferred '_ return lifetimes and remove
  the unused usize payload from the private initial parser state (always 0,
  always ignored). Parser transitions and public data types are unchanged.
All other upstream source files remain unchanged.

LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE are copied from the source commit above.
When replacing this dependency with an upstream fix, remove the Cargo patch
and this directory together, then rerun parser and inbox regressions.
